name: Letterpress studio card macro
nameJa: 活版印圧・コットン名刺

prompt.existence: The logo exists as a deep letterpress impression pressed into thick cotton paper, ink-free blind deboss
prompt.material: 600gsm cotton stock with visible fiber texture, the impression casting its own micro-shadows
prompt.environment: A single business card on a printmaker's stone table, loupe and ink knife out of focus nearby
prompt.light: One low-angle softbox skimming the surface to carve out the deboss
prompt.camera: Extreme macro, shallow depth of field centered on the mark
prompt.contextWrap: The card belongs to a business in this field: {context}
prompt.negative: color printing, gloss, watermark, text other than the logo

color.reasonJa: インクなしの空押し表現のため、色保持は意味を持たない(固定)

notesJa: ダイヤルロックの代表例: 色軸を固定し、形状・文字の保持だけが効く。保証モードの名刺テンプレートとの見比べ(決定論 vs 探索)にも使える。
